name: clipugc
description: Create AI influencer characters, looks, video clips and merged UGC app ads with ClipUGC.
long_description:
ClipUGC makes UGC-style ads for mobile apps with AI creators. This extension gives Claude Desktop the same tools as the `clipugc` command line: create an AI character, generate more looks of the same face, animate a look into a short silent-reaction clip, merge your app screen recording under a hook text, and download the finished ad.

You need a ClipUGC account on a paid plan and an API key from https://clipugc.com/dashboard (API Keys). Generation spends credits from your ClipUGC balance; the `get_credits` tool shows the balance and the live cost of each action.

api_key.title: ClipUGC API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://clipugc.com/dashboard under API Keys

tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: List your AI characters, or browse public ones. Costs no credits.

tools.name: create_character
tools.description: Create a new AI character from a plain-language description. 2 credits.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate more looks (photos) of an existing character, same face in a new setting. 2 credits per look.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List the looks of a character and their generation status. Costs no credits.

tools.name: create_clip
tools.description: Animate a look or your own photo into a 5 or 10 second video clip. 7 or 13 credits.

tools.name: create_motion_clip
tools.description: Animate a look or photo by copying the motion of a driver video. 3 credits per driver second.

tools.name: merge_ad
tools.description: Merge a finished clip with your app screen recording and a hook text into a UGC ad. Free at the moment; get_credits shows the live cost.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Get the status of a clip or a merged ad. Use it to poll until generation completes. Costs no credits.

tools.name: download_video
tools.description: Download a completed clip or ad to a local mp4 file. Costs no credits.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Show your credit balance and the live cost of each action. Costs no credits.

tools.name: list_hooks
tools.description: Suggest hook texts for an ad based on a short description of your app. Costs no credits.
